[[Kenta Miyake]] ([[JN068]]-present)| }} '''Gary's Electivire''' (Japanese: '''シゲルのエレキブル''' ''Shigeru's Elekible'') was a {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that {{Gary}} {{pkmn2|caught}} in the [[Sinnoh]] [[region]]. It is the first Pokémon known to have been obtained by him after he became a {{pkmn|Professor|Pokémon Researcher}}. ==In animation== ===={{aniseries|AG}}==== [[File:AG192.png|thumb|left|220px|Electivire battling Pikachu]] Electivire was {{pkmn2|caught}} during Gary's journey through [[Sinnoh]] sometime during his research in this region. Its first appearance was in ''[[AG192|Home Is Where the Start Is!]]''. It looked as if it was a wild {{p|Electivire}} at first because it was shooting apples by itself from a tree with its {{m|Thunderbolt}}. {{TRT}} attempted to take it by capturing it in an electricity-proof net. It looked as if they were about to succeed until Gary showed up and told it to use {{m|Iron Tail}} to cut free of the net. In the end, it zapped and blasted Jessie, James, and Meowth off with {{m|Thunder Punch}} to finish. {{Ash}} was impressed by Electivire, but as he looked it up on his [[Pokédex]], there was no data on it. Ash then wanted to battle it, but Gary said to come back to the [[Professor Oak's Laboratory|lab]] first. Once there, Ash sent out his {{AP|Pikachu}} to fight Electivire. Unfortunately for him, Electivire proved too much for Pikachu to handle and he ended up losing. When Gary left for Sinnoh, he took Electivire with him. ===={{aniseries|DP}}==== [[File:Gary Umbreon Electivire J henchmen.png|thumb|220px|Electivire and Umbreon attacking J's henchmen]] Electivire appeared again in ''[[DP045|Ill-Will Hunting!]]'' as it fought by Gary's side against [[J|Pokémon Hunter J]] and [[J's henchmen|her henchmen]] in order to protect the {{p|Shieldon}} from being captured. It was called on again to sabotage J's ship, using Thunderbolt to cause explosions and then tackling J's henchmen with {{TP|Gary|Umbreon}} to allow Ash to retrieve Shieldon. Gary used Electivire and Umbreon to battle against [[Saturn's Toxicroak]] in ''[[DP151|The Needs of the Three!]]'', when trying to stop Pokémon Hunter J from giving the three {{an|lake guardians}} to the [[Team Galactic]] {{tc|Commander}}. However, {{p|Toxicroak}} had both of them under control at all times. When Electivire attempted to use {{m|Thunder}} to stop Hunter J, it was badly hurt by Toxicroak's {{m|Poison Jab}} before it could attack. ===={{aniseries|JN}}==== Gary used Electivire to battle against a wild {{p|Moltres}} in ''[[JN068|Advice to Goh!]]'', alongside Ash's Pikachu. After landing a Thunder attack, Moltres flew off, but not before leaving a burning feather behind, allowing Gary to complete his [[Field Research|Trial Mission]] and earn a token from [[Project Mew]]. In ''[[JN134|In the Palms of our Hands!]]'', Gary used Electivire alongside [[Horace]]'s {{p|Virizion}}, [[Danika]]'s {{p|Jellicent}}, and [[Quillon]]'s {{p|Honchkrow}} to battle {{an|Mew}}. Despite their best efforts, the Pokémon were easily defeated. ===Personality and characteristics=== [[File:Gary and Electivire.png|thumb|220px|Electivire and Gary]] Since its introduction, Electivire has also become one of Gary's most used Pokémon. In contrast to [[Paul's Electivire]], Gary's Electivire seems to be more jolly and sportful, as seen in its debut and battle with [[Ash's Pikachu]]. ===Moves used=== {{anmov/h|electric||Gary Electivire {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 5}}|0=Thunderbolt|1=Iron Tail|2=ThunderPunch|3=Protect|4=Thunder}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 5}}|0=Thunderbolt|1=Iron Tail|2=Thunder Punch|3=Protect|4=Thunder}}}} {{anmov|electric|Thunderbolt|AG192|Home Is Where the Start Is!}} {{anmov|steel|Iron Tail|AG192|Home Is Where the Start Is!}} {{anmov|electric|Thunder Punch|AG192|Home Is Where the Start Is!}} {{anmov|normal|Protect|AG192|Home Is Where the Start Is!}} {{anmov|electric|Thunder|DP151|The Needs of the Three!|rec=yes}} {{anmov/f|electric}} ====Moves improvised==== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{electric color}}; border: 3px solid #{{electric color dark}}; {{roundy}}" |- ! {{color|FFF|Picture}} ! {{color|FFF|First Used In}} ! {{color|FFF|Moves Involved}} ! {{color|FFF|Partnered With}} |- style="background:#FFF" | rowspan="2" | [[File:Thunderbolt Thunder combo 1.png|150px]]
